items.title: Police killer Dezi Freeman had hundreds of child abuse files
items.description: Police killer Dezi Freeman was on the verge of having his secret stash of child abuse material discovered when he gunned down two officers outside his makeshift home.

items.title: King's speech to Congress hits on several Trump controversies
items.description: In a speech that was supposed to be apolitical, King Charles hits on some hot-button issues that are fuelling controversies around the Trump administration.

items.title: Former ASIO chief raised questions about assessment of Bondi gunman
items.description: While advising the royal commission examining the Bondi Beach terrorist attack, the former head of Australia's domestic intelligence agency questioned whether early assessments of gunman Naveed Akram were sufficiently rigorous.

items.title: As search for missing 5yo Sharon continues, a clearer picture of that night emerges
items.description: Five-year-old Sharon Granites vanished from an Alice Springs town camp late on Saturday night, with police alleging she has been abducted. Here's what we know about the night she went missing.

items.title: Parents slam 'weak' school response after 21 girls targeted in deepfake scandal
items.description: Two parents of girls at a private school have criticised the institution's response to a deepfake incident, saying they were encouraged not to tell their daughters they had been identified in material shared in a boys' group chat.

items.title: El Niño one step closer as Pacific transition now fastest in 50 years
items.description: Australia's weather pattern is in a reset, and the weather events happening this month will act like the ingredients to determine the flavour of our climate for the rest of the year.

items.title: Live: PM to announce $45 million to fast-track housing, energy projects
items.description: The prime minister will announce $45 million to help speed housing and energy project approvals. Follow live.

items.title: 'Double-headed monster' set to push up prices at the check-out
items.description: Companies that use plastic packaging are facing price pressures and supply disruptions, which they warn will likely mean higher costs for consumers. The cost of food-grade resin out of Singapore, which is used in milk bottles, has increased 110 per cent since the start of the Middle East war.

items.title: Live: US Marines board suspected Iran blockade runner, Israel hits Gaza, Lebanon
items.description: US President Donald Trump says Iranian leadership has told him they are in a "state of collapse" and are urging him to reopen the Strait of Hormuz, as US marines board cargo ships in the region and Israeli strikes kill three in Lebanon. Follow live.

items.title: Melbourne-to-Queensland exodus in 'reversal' amid housing unaffordability
items.description: South-East Queensland has been under-represented in 5% Deposit Scheme approvals, with prospective first-home buyers heading to Melbourne for its "considerable affordability" benefits.

items.title: Does the gas industry pay its fair share of tax?
items.description: Advocates are proposing a flat 25 per cent tax on gas exports, but representatives say the industry is being unfairly targeted.

items.title: Australia risks repeating social media mistakes with AI in workplace: report
items.description: Australia risks repeating the mistakes it made with social media unless it moves quickly to regulate the spread of artificial intelligence in the workplace, according to a new report.

items.title: Live: Inflation likely to reach highest level since 2023, ASX to drop for seventh straight day
items.description: The ABS is set to release data that is likely to show inflation spiking at about 4.8 per cent in the March quarter, its highest level in two and a half years. The RBA is widely expected to lift interest rates again next week.

items.title: UK PM Starmer avoids parliamentary probe over Mandelson
items.description: Sir Keir Starmer criticised the vote, calling it a political stunt by the Conservative Party timed to sway voters ahead of local and regional elections on May 7.

items.title: How do the 2026 winter vaccines fare against new virus variants?
items.description: With winter just around the corner, now is the perfect time to get vaccinated against seasonal flu and other viruses.

items.title: Worried about a neighbour's dog? Here's what you can do
items.description: An unhappy dog doesn't necessarily mean criminal neglect, even if the level of care is below what you would give your own pet.

items.title: Travel quiz: Grab your ticket and a map, we're off on an adventure
items.description: The Galápagos Islands are part of which South American country? The Elgin Marbles were taken from which ancient site?

items.title: Port Arthur gun reform was swift. Bondi is proving a different challenge
items.description: Firearms reforms were swift and lasting after Port Arthur. But Bondi has proved a far more challenging political process for the federal government. So where are we at with the gun law reforms?

items.title: Refinery upgrades could ease threat of future fuel supply blockages
items.description: As the international fuel crisis continues to cause concern, the federal government is under pressure to provide a fix during next month's budget.

items.title: Hundreds of jobs to go at Home Affairs amid 'financial pressures'
items.description: The secretary of the second-largest department says she has been trying to reduce headcount by natural attrition, but that further job cuts are needed by the end of the financial year to fit within the department's budget.

items.title: Video captures moment Pilates studio set alight in brazen arson attack
items.description: The video released by police captures the moment a man douses the Pilates studio in petrol before setting it alight.

items.title: VicGrid surveyors cancel access visit after farmgate protest makes them feel unsafe
items.description: Renewable planning body VicGrid has threatened a high-profile anti-transmission-line campaigner with enforcement action after government surveyors felt "hindered" from accessing his farm.

items.title: Experts offer theories on why WA is 'wild west' for ADHD prescriptions
items.description: With WA home to seven out of Australia's top-10 highest ADHD prescribing neighbourhoods, experts, psychiatrists and doctors weigh in with their theories.

items.title: Greens sound alarm after salmon farm pours tonnes of antibiotics into waterway
items.description: Almost 3 tonnes of the antibiotic florfenicol were used at one Tasmanian salmon farm lease in just two months, with information on its use across eight other sites yet to be released to the public by authorities.

items.title: Dad watched savings 'crash and burn' due to fake investment platform
items.description: The Sydney dad believed he was investing in cryptocurrency, stocks and even gold with the hopes of buying a home.
